story.zh:
黑胡椒和野草本气息一股脑冲出来，却还稳稳兜着那口冰糖山楂般的酸甜果味，单宁又软得不像话——真的绝了🤯。喝过 Muto 家这么多款红酒，这一支大概刚刚把黑皮诺挤下去，登顶我心里的 Muto 红酒最爱榜。

100% 国产多瑞加，来自 Barmera 一处有机兼生物动力的 Bassham 家族园。大部分整串入罐，野生酵母发酵、辅以脚踩破皮，早晚各手工压帽一次，再篮式压榨进旧橡木大桶（仅 10% 新桶）陈酿十个月。最后由家族亲手装瓶，几乎不加二氧化硫——不折不扣的自然酒。
story.en:
Black pepper and wild herbs come barrelling out, and yet it still hangs onto this candied-hawthorn sweet-and-sour fruit, tannins soft as you like — genuinely mind-blowing 🤯. Of all the Muto reds I've worked my way through, this one might have just bumped the Pinot off the top spot.

It's 100% Touriga Nacional off the Bassham family's organic, biodynamic vineyard in Barmera — mostly whole-bunch, wild-fermented with a bit of foot-treading, hand-plunged morning and night, then basket-pressed to old puncheons (just 10% new oak) for ten months. Bottled by the family's own hands with barely any added sulphur. Natural wine that actually delivers.

pairing.zh: 配韩式烤肉（Bulgogi）——薄切牛肉的蒜香和那一点点甜，正好接住酒里的黑胡椒与草本香气。
pairing.en: With Korean bulgogi — the garlic and gentle sweetness of the thin-sliced beef catch the wine's black pepper and herbal side just right.

notes.zh: 河地（Riverland）是南澳产量最大的葡萄酒产区，沿墨累河铺开，气候炎热干燥。过去以量取胜，如今聚集了越来越多做自然酒、玩小众品种的小酒庄。Barmera 则是产区里临 Bonney 湖的一座小镇。
notes.en: The Riverland is South Australia's largest wine region by volume, sprawling along the Murray River under a hot, dry sky. Long a bulk-wine workhorse, it's now a magnet for small producers making natural wine and alternative varieties. Barmera is a little town on Lake Bonney right in the thick of it.

wine_name.zh: 扬加拉 老藤歌海娜 2021

story.zh:
麦克拉伦谷的老藤歌海娜，颜色浅得像放大版桃红，别被骗了——香气一上来就是熟透的草莓加一把干香草。

入口轻盈多汁，单宁细得几乎察觉不到，微微的胡椒尾韵让它一点都不腻。冰镇十五分钟再喝，夏天傍晚神器。
story.en:
An old-vine Grenache from McLaren Vale, so pale it looks like a rosé that hit the gym — don't be fooled. The nose is all ripe strawberry and a fistful of dried herbs.

Light and juicy on the palate, tannins so fine you barely notice them, with a peppery lift on the finish that keeps it from ever feeling heavy. Fifteen minutes in the fridge and it's a summer-evening hero.

pairing.zh: 微微冰镇后配炭火羊排、番茄冷盘，或者就着一盘火腿也行。
pairing.en: Lightly chilled, with lamb off the grill, a tomato salad — or honestly just a plate of jamón.

summary.zh: 浅色不代表清淡——多汁草莓、细腻单宁、胡椒尾韵，冰一冰就是夏夜万金油。
summary.en: Pale but not shy — juicy strawberry, silky tannins, a peppery finish. Chill it and it goes with anything.

notes.zh: 麦克拉伦谷位于阿德莱德以南，地中海式气候加上古老砂质土壤，是南澳歌海娜与罗讷风格红酒的宝地。
notes.en: McLaren Vale, just south of Adelaide, pairs a Mediterranean climate with ancient sandy soils — prime country for South Australian Grenache and Rhône-style reds.

wine_name.zh: 卡普里亚德 「少女陷阱」气泡
wine_name.en: Les Capriades Pétillant « Piège à Filles »

story.zh:
卢瓦尔河谷祖传法气泡（Pét-Nat）名门，开瓶记得小心——气很足，跑得比你手快。

气泡细腻，青苹果加一点面包发酵香，酸度爽脆但不咬人，尾巴干净带一丝洋甘菊花香。不装、不端着，就是让人一杯接一杯的那种酒。
story.en:
A benchmark pét-nat from a Loire cult producer — open it carefully, there's a lot of gas and it moves faster than your hand.

Fine bubbles, green apple and a little bready lees character, crisp acidity that never bites, and a clean finish with a whisper of chamomile. No airs, no pretension — just the kind of bottle that empties itself one glass at a time.

pairing.zh: 一晚的开胃第一杯，配炸物、生蚝，或者只配好心情。
pairing.en: The first pour of the night — with anything fried, fresh oysters, or just good company.

summary.zh: 细泡、脆酸、青苹果加烤面包香——毫无距离感的开胃气泡，一开就见底。
summary.en: Fine bubbles, crisp acidity, green apple and brioche — an approachable aperitif fizz that disappears fast.

varieties.zh: 白诗南 / 默尼耶皮诺

notes.zh: 卡普里亚德是卢瓦尔河谷祖传法（méthode ancestrale）气泡的标杆，一次发酵在瓶中完成，不加糖不加酵母，天然带气。
notes.en: Les Capriades is a reference point for méthode ancestrale in the Loire — a single fermentation finished in the bottle, no added sugar or yeast, naturally sparkling.
